application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief
application.note: Satellite (maintainer, 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-16): batteries of 1U CubeSats in orbit, a class of its own, kept separate from eVTOL and aerospace.

units_released.note: Rule: one battery per satellite. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: The batteries are NiMH; a lithium-ion cell count does not apply.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: No individual cell-voltage channels are released.

energy_mwh.source: 4 satellites x 6 NiMH cells (3S2P) x 2.0 Ah x 1.2 V, paper Table 2 / 1,000,000
energy_mwh.note: Computed from the stated configuration; not computable from the data (no SOC).

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from stated configuration

span_unit_years.note: The release has no calendar timestamps.

obs_hours.note: records have no calendar timestamps (time is seconds within one orbit's collection), so service time is observation-hours: sum of sheet spans, test sheets left out

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.17632/8kp25ycf63.1; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
